title: Jyn Erso
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Abandoned in the care of Saw Gerrera after the Empire killed her mother and abducted her father, Jyn Erso found herself fighting the Empire as one of Saw's partisans. Until Saw abandoned her. Headstrong and rebellious, Jyn gave up on her father and the cause until the Rebellion caught up to her and she learned the truth, ultimately sacrificing her life to stop the Death Star, just like her father.
